metadata.description: Team marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: design-docs-plugin
plugins.description: Grills you one question at a time to capture design decisions, then writes a full docs/ folder (overview, data model, Mermaid flow, ADRs) before you write any code.

plugins.name: language-guide-plugin
plugins.description: Applies a shared writing-style guide (plain, B2-level English) whenever documentation prose is written or reviewed — wikis, READMEs, PR descriptions, ADRs, design docs.
